caption: The drawing consists of two views of a tall, rectangular grandfather clock rendered in black ink on a light, off-white background. The left view shows the front of the clock, which features an ornate top section with decorative molding and pillars framing a circular clock face. The clock face displays Roman numerals, two hands, and some decorative elements, and is set into a section with a semi-circular motif above it. Below the clock face, the central portion of the clock body is elongated with wood grain detailing, ending in a rectangular base with similar wood grain effects. The base sits on four short, bracketed feet. The overall height and key dimensions are marked in inches; 18 inches wide at the base, with notable sections measured as 23 ½ inches, 42 inches, and 18 ½ inches in height, as well as 9 ½ inches in depth. The right view shows the clock in profile, displaying the same top molding, pillar, and base details, with an arch at the top center and the same textural wood grain effect. The drawing is enclosed within a thin rectangular border. At the bottom right corner, the name "Ernest Towers Jr." is inscribed.
title: Clock
